chaining.sources.body: Option of the From picker of an extract rule: read the value from the JSON body.
chaining.sources.header: Option: read the value from a response header.
chaining.sources.cookie: Option: read the value from a cookie set by the response.
chaining.sources.status: Option: use the HTTP status code of the response.
chaining.enterPath: {{example}} is a JSONPath expression. Keep it as given.
chaining.invalidPath: {{error}} is a technical message in English.
chaining.noMatch: Shown in the value column of an extract rule when the path finds nothing.
chaining.badVariableName: Keep the single closing brace as given.
